title: fix(plugin-approvals): a reminder's notification payload carries no one-tap action token
body:
Fixes #24564

Clause-②: no — the change narrows what the platform persists; it is a runtime security-boundary change, so it sits on the human floor and its PR stays draft until the maintainer approves

## What changes

- **`remind()` mints no action token and attaches no link.** Each concrete pending approver still gets their own `approval.reminder` notification, with the same title, body, deep link (`/system/approvals?request=ID`) and dedup key. The payload handed to `messaging` no longer carries an `actions` list, and `remind()` no longer calls `issueActionTokens`.
- **The approval notification payload type no longer accepts links.** `ApprovalNotificationPayload` drops its optional `actions` member, so a call site that hands a link to `notify()` does not compile. Its doc says why: messaging keeps this payload, verbatim on the `sys_notification` event row and snapshotted onto each `sys_notification_delivery` row, and ADR-0043's storage axis is that the database holds no usable link.
- **`issueActionTokens` states the caller's half of that guarantee.** A raw token, or a URL built from one, is never written to a persisted row (a notification payload, an audit row, a log line). It travels only in a message that is sent and not kept.
- **Untouched:** the token store, the action page (`GET` and `POST /api/v1/approvals/act`), peek and redeem. A redeemed token still decides as the approver it binds.

## How the links were delivered before, and why the fix is at the producer

Read in this repository at the merge base `de43524`:

- The reminder's emit names no channel, so messaging falls back to the in-app `inbox` channel (`MessagingService.emit`). Delivery preferences only remove channels; they never add one.
- The inbox materialization (`sys_inbox_message`) keeps the title, the body and the action URL, never `actions`. The console bell reads `sys_inbox_message`.
- No channel in this repository (inbox, email, SMS) reads `payload.actions`, and no `approval.reminder` template exists.

So no recipient received the links through any channel, and the stored payload rows were the only copies. Carrying the links only on a synchronous send has no send to ride on, and minting them at delivery time would be new plumbing for a channel that renders no links. Neither is needed to make the contract hold, so the producer stops putting them in. Nothing a recipient sees changes.

## Tokens stored before this fix

A reminder sent by an earlier build stored its links. Each such token is dead at its 72-hour expiry (`ACTION_TOKEN_TTL_MS`), or earlier: once it is used, once its request leaves `pending`, or once its slot is reassigned. No revocation migration ships. 18.0 is a fresh-install release, so no 18.0 deployment holds such rows, and on a development database they lapse within 72 hours. The rows themselves age out under the notification tables' retention, 90 days at most.

## Tests

Run at head `63262a2` (the branch with `origin/main` at `5a871e4` merged in), unless a line says otherwise.

- **New: `reminder-action-link-at-rest.integration.test.ts`.** A real `ObjectQL` over `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3, in-memory), the real plugin and the real `sys_notification` object. Live tokens are minted and held in memory, so every scan can fail.
  - No emit input, and no row of any table in the database, holds an action-page URL or a string whose SHA-256 is a live token's digest.
  - The data door's read of `sys_notification` serves the reminder event and nothing redeemable in it.
  - The reminder mints no token and reaches its approver with the deep link.
  - Positive control: the action page decides once as the bound approver (`actor_id` and `acted_as` are that approver, `via_override` is false) and refuses a replay.
- **Updated:** `approval-service.test.ts` (the remind pin asserts per-approver reminders with no link and no mint), `approval-notification-body.integration.test.ts` (the declared payload fields no longer include `actions`), `sys-approval-token-generic-door.integration.test.ts` (mints with `issueActionTokens` instead of reading a link off a reminder).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals test`: 82 files, 1116 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals typecheck`: exit 0.
- **Ablation** (one-time, not committed). The old mint-and-attach was restored in `remind()` with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit once, file restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty) and the four test files above were run: 7 tests went red in three of them, namely the three at-rest pins (the positive control stayed green), the remind unit pin and three body-battery pins. The token-door file stayed green, as it mints directly. The at-rest pin's failure lists the action URL both in the emit input and in the stored `sys_notification` row.
- **Live, on a fresh showcase boot of this branch at `466a4fd`** (before the `origin/main` merge, which touched neither package). After a reminder, the stored `sys_notification`, `sys_notification_delivery` and `sys_inbox_message` rows for it carry no action link: one reminder row in each table, zero hits in each.

## Gates

- Local: the derived set for this diff (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 69 commands) run at `63262a2`, every one exit 0; `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reconciles 69 derived, 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. That includes the `check:type-check-debt` re-measure, the `check:query-options-erasure` ratchet and `check:test-source-alias`.
- Not run locally, left to CI: the repo-wide families (`pnpm lint` and the rest of the lint workflow), the `test:repo` vitest project, and the cross-package consumers of `@objectstack/plugin-approvals`, whose public surface is unchanged.
- CI: in progress when this PR opened.

## Acceptance notes

- **ADR-0043 now says more than the code does in one place.** Its Mechanics bullet says `remind()` gives each concrete approver "their own approve/reject links", and its Non-goals say "the links ride the existing messaging payloads". After this PR no notification carries a link. `docs/adr/**` is a governed surface outside this card's file surface, so it is not edited here; an amendment status line is the maintainer's call.
- **The platform checklist item `approvals.email-action-token-door`** (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json`) captures live tokens from the stored reminder payload. That capture no longer exists, and after this change no REST door mints a token, so the item needs a revision. It is outside this card's file surface.
- `actionLinkUrl` and the plugin's `publicBaseUrl` option keep their contract but have no first-party caller now. They stay, together with `issueActionTokens` and the action page.
- Not measured: whether any channel outside this repository reads `payload.actions`. This session has no access to that code.
- `remind()` counts a slot that a per-group slate lists twice as two in `notified`, while messaging dedups the second emit. This is unchanged here and was seen on the live boot.
- The end-to-end pin through the real messaging service and the REST data door belongs to the dogfood layer (`packages/qa/dogfood`), outside this card's file surface. The in-package pin covers the producer boundary and every stored row of a real engine.
